scientific_integrity: The global ordering and equality set are proved analytically from the exact Bloch relation and strict convexity; finite numerical checks are corroborative only. Literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent observation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the free equilateral standard-Kirchhoff cubic lattice and the principal Bloch branch; no higher-band, potential, magnetic, or unequal-edge claim is made.
title: Directional underdispersion and exact body-diagonal rays in cubic lattice quantum graphs
